arxiv-2112-12562.title: Artificial Intelligence Supported Shell-Model Calculations for Light Sn Isotopes
arxiv-2112-12562.creator: Serkan Akkoyun 1, Abderrahmane Yakhelef 2,3
arxiv-2112-12562.description: Abstract The region around the doubly magic nuclide S 100 ​ n {}^{100}Sn is very interesting for nuclear physics studies in terms of structure, reaction and nuclear astrophysics. The main ingredients in nuclear structure studies using the shell model are the single-particle energies and the two-body matrix elements.

arxiv-2207-11643.title: Robust Scene Inference under Noise-Blur Dual Corruptions
arxiv-2207-11643.creator: Bhavya Goyal, Jean-François Lalonde, Yin Li, Mohit Gupta
arxiv-2207-11643.description: Abstract Scene inference under low-light is a challenging problem due to severe noise in the captured images. One way to reduce noise is to use longer exposure during the capture. However, in the presence of motion (scene or camera motion), longer exposures lead to motion blur, resulting in loss of image information.

arxiv-2312-06792.title: Double points and image of reflection maps Thanks: The first author has been partially supported by CAPES. The second author has been suported by Grant PGC2018-094889-B-100 funded by MCIN/AEI/ 10.13039/501100011033 and by “ERDF A way of making Europe”. The third has been supported by FAPESP-Grant 20
arxiv-2312-06792.creator: J. R. Borges-Zampiva, B. Oréfice-Okamoto, G. Peñafort Sanchis, J.N. Tomazella
arxiv-2312-06792.description: Abstract . A reflection mapping is a singular holomorphic mapping obtained by restricting the quotient mapping of a complex reflection group. We study the analytic structure of double point spaces of reflection mappings. In the case where the image is a hypersurface, we obtain explicit equations for the double point space and for the image as well.

arxiv-2407-16639.title: Distortion Recovery: A Two-Stage Method for Guitar Effect Removal
arxiv-2407-16639.description: Abstract Removing audio effects from electric guitar recordings makes it easier for post-production and sound editing. An audio distortion recovery model not only improves the clarity of the guitar sounds but also opens up new opportunities for creative adjustments in mixing and mastering.

arxiv-2502-18673.title: Scaffolding Empathy: Training Counselors with Simulated Patients and Utterance-level Performance Visualizations
arxiv-2502-18673.creator: Ian Steenstra, Farnaz Nouraei, Timothy W. Bickmore
arxiv-2502-18673.description: Abstract . Learning therapeutic counseling involves significant role-play experience with mock patients, with current manual training methods providing only intermittent granular feedback. We seek to accelerate and optimize counselor training by providing frequent, detailed feedback to trainees as they interact with a simulated patient. Our first application domain involves training motivational interviewing skills for counselors.

arxiv-2507-14632.title: BusterX++: Towards Unified Cross-Modal AI-Generated Content Detection and Explanation with MLLM
arxiv-2507-14632.creator: Haiquan Wen, Tianxiao Li, Zhenglin Huang, Yiwei He, Guangliang Cheng
arxiv-2507-14632.description: Abstract Recent advances in generative AI have dramatically improved image and video synthesis capabilities, significantly increasing the risk of misinformation through sophisticated fake content. In response, detection methods have evolved from traditional approaches to multimodal large language models (MLLMs), offering enhanced transparency and interpretability in identifying synthetic media. However, current detection systems remain fundamentally limited by their single-modality design.

arxiv-2511-09385.title: AMaPO: Adaptive Margin-attached Preference Optimization for Language Model Alignment
arxiv-2511-09385.creator: Ruibo Deng, Duanyu Feng, Wenqiang Lei
arxiv-2511-09385.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ruibo Deng, Duanyu Feng, Wenqiang Lei. Offline preference optimization offers a simpler and more stable alternative to RLHF for aligning language models. However, their effectiveness is critically dependent on ranking accuracy, a metric where further gains are highly impactful. This limitation arises from a fundamental problem that we identify and formalize as the Overfitting-Underfitting Dilemma: current margin designs cause models to apply excessive, wasteful gradients to correctly ranked samples (overfitting) while providing insufficient corrective signals for misranked ones (underfitting).

pmc-10710950.title: Relationship Between Dyadic Coping with Anxiety and Depression in Infertile Couples: Gender Differences and Dyadic Interaction
pmc-10710950.creator: Nan Tang, Mengyue Pei, Lei Xie, Xueping Liang, Junping Hu, Yuan Gao
pmc-10710950.description: BackgroundThis study aims to examine the relationship between anxiety and depression and dyadic coping in infertile couples, exploring gender differences and dyadic interactions in these associations.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted involving 288 couples recruited from the First Affiliated Hospital of Lanzhou University between November 2021 and November 2022.

pmc-10719269.title: Effect of external subretinal fluid drainage on persistent subretinal fluid after scleral buckle surgery in macula-involving rhegmatogenous retinal detachment
pmc-10719269.creator: Jae Rok Do, Dong Ho Park, Jae Pil Shin, Yong Koo Kang
pmc-10719269.description: This study aimed to analyze the duration and causes of persistent subretinal fluid (PSF) after scleral buckle (SB) surgery in patients with macula-involving rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (RRD). Sixty-one eyes of 61 patients with macula-involving RRD who underwent SB surgery between 2016 and 2022 were reviewed retrospectively. PSF was confirmed on optical coherence tomography.

pmc-12524405.title: Health-Related Quality of Life Among High-Risk Pregnant Women Hospitalized in a Maternal-Fetal Intensive Care Unit: A Structural Equation Modeling Analysis
pmc-12524405.creator: Hyuna Seol, Jina Oh, Mihae Im, Ines Aguinaga-Ontoso
pmc-12524405.description: Objectives: The aim of this study was to establish a structural model that could explain and predict factors influencing health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in high-risk pregnant women. Methods: This study adopted a structural equation model based on the HRQoL model. Data were collected from 200 high-risk pregnant women hospitalized in a maternal-fetal intensive care unit.

pmc-13197565.title: Effects of Acute and Chronic Physical Exercise on Esports Performance: A Systematic Review
pmc-13197565.creator: Felix Wachholz, Fynn Coenen, Martin Zhang, Heiko Heidenreich
pmc-13197565.description: BackgroundRecent evidence suggests that structured physical exercise (PE) may enhance electronic sports (esports) performance by targeting physiological and cognitive mechanisms similar to those known from traditional athletic training. Esports require rapid decision-making, sustained attention, and fine motor abilities—capacities strongly influenced by regular PE.

pmc-13297568.description: Simple SummaryBreast cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related death among women, and early detection is essential to improve patient outcomes. Although mammography is the standard screening method, access to this technology remains unequal in many regions, including Peru.

pmc-13418992.title: Synergistic effects of ambient particulate matter and extreme weather events on arthritis risk: a prospective cohort study
pmc-13418992.creator: Yongbin Wang, Weihang Liu, Yongsheng Liao, Ruiting Zhao, Chunjie Xu, Fei Lin
pmc-13418992.description: BackgroundThe role of long-term exposure to a comprehensive panel of particulate matter (PM) size fractions and extreme weather events in the development of incident arthritis remains underexplored. We aimed to evaluate their independent, combined, and interactive effects on arthritis risk in a Chinese middle-aged and older population.

pmc-13441217.creator: Gerard J Gormley, Jacqueline Driscoll, Linda Ní Chianáin
